item.title: 8 backcountry skiers found dead and 1 still missing after California avalanche
item.description: TRUCKEE, Calif. (AP) — Crews found the bodies of eight backcountry skiers near California's Lake Tahoe and were searching for one more after they were caught in an avalanche, the nation's deadliest in nearly half a century, authorities said Wednesday. item.title: Winter Olympics recap: Shiffrin takes slalom gold, Canada and US advance with OT wins in hockey
item.description: CORTINA D’AMPEZZO, Italy (AP) — Redemption, at last, for Mikaela Shiffrin at the Winter Olympics. The American superstar put in two dominant runs to win the women’s slalom on Wednesday by a massive 1.50 seconds, ending a run of eight straight Olympic races without a medal for perhaps the greatest Alpine skier of all time. item.title: Burn bans expanded to 17 Iowa counties amid dry, windy conditions
item.description: DES MOINES, Iowa -- Seven more Iowa counties have enacted burn bans as the state experiences abnormally dry conditions, and winds are expected to gust over 40 mph.
